concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-merchant-advice-codes]] - optional Mastercard decline advice in transaction responses, including do-not-retry, stop-recurring, later-retry and exact wait-duration codes with separate authorization-retry restrictions preserved
warnings: Do not present MAC presence as universal or infer a retry instruction when the fields are absent.
Do not treat a retry-oriented MAC as overriding processor-response prohibitions, recurring-payment restrictions or operation-specific state checks.
Preserve exact table wording and durations; code 02 supplies no duration and codes 24 through 30 do.
